scope: Issues 72–74, issue 31 rename, and all issue 62 failures/pins with documented vendor replacements.
notes: Three new submission runtime files and patches match the public source byte for byte.

Argo is version-pinned with repositoryReview because its npm manifest omits repository. Exact source package: packages/dsh-plugin at d9fea8b6cdf492a69d1f334019ff311b8dfc0fdc; repository root contains Apache-2.0 LICENSE. It has no packaged icon; normal fallback applies.

Argo routing verified against the integrity-checked official rc.2 web and base archives: defaults pin http, custom profiles without a selected provider are ambiguous. This is a documented configuration prerequisite, not a default-profile installation failure.

Scratchpad puts its compatibility claim in dsh.engines.dsh instead of engines.dsh, so the generated official index has no range; the description states the README requirement and this review records the field limitation.

Error Atlas has separate labelled built-in development-error examples. Live records are read from the current Host store; built-in examples are not injected as user lessons. Its HTTP API permits loopback connections only.

Vendor runtime/Jina/Cohere are compiled npm artifacts; their public source, entry identities, patch rows, service activation and API paths were inspected. Compiled bytes are not claimed identical to TypeScript source.

description.en: Record runtime failures and coding retrospectives locally, explore a WebGL knowledge graph and recall lessons through tools and optional context injection. The panel API accepts local connections only; the package declares no DSH version range.

replies.body: 感谢提交！已核查 dsh-error-atlas@0.11.26，将在下个提交后收录 😊
感谢提交！已核查 @chaiyahang/dsh-scratchpad@0.2.3，将在下个提交后收录 😊
感谢提交！已核查 @taxueseek/argo-dsh@2.9.8，将按固定版本收录，并补充源码核查记录和 Python/PyYAML、网页工具路由配置要求 😊
感谢补充！已核查 @feiwell/dsh-enhance-prompt@0.2.0 的固定提交 72524db41749dd6faa0820e58cd94dcbcd47d1e6、归档 SHA-512 和补丁，Host/客户端运行代码未变，将在下个提交中替换旧包名 😊

本轮复查结果如下：

- `@dsh-ai-providers/jina-cohere@0.5.1` 的 README 已明确说明它是公共库，不是插件，因此不再要求该库补 bundle。按作者推荐，收录项改为 `@dsh-ai-providers/runtime`、`@dsh-ai-providers/jina` 和 `@dsh-ai-providers/cohere`，本轮核查版本均为 0.5.1，归档、补丁与 Host/客户端入口完整。Jina/Cohere 需要先安装并启用 runtime，仅下载依赖不会自动启用它，市场介绍中已说明。公共库会由依赖安装，不再单列为可安装插件。
- Workbench、BTW、主题插件：当前固定的旧版本和最新 rc.3 Git 归档都缺少 `exports["./client"]` 指向的 `lib/client.js`。三个旧版本的配置仍保留，但线上构建会排除它们；此前“保留旧版”并不代表归档完整或仍在市场展示。
- Extensions 和 Persona：旧固定版本包含完整客户端，继续保留；最新 rc.3 Git 归档缺少 `lib/client.js`，暂不升级。

请给以上五个 Git 插件提供包含预构建 Host/客户端文件的公开 npm 包，或把构建产物提交到可安装的仓库根目录并提供完整 SHA。Workbench、BTW、主题插件还需补齐当前固定版本，或提供可替代的完整版本。GitHub Release 的 tgz 附件与固定 Git 源码归档不同，当前来源规则不能直接替用。收到后会重新核查 rc.3 兼容范围。

维护单继续保留；完整构建与发布仍交给 GitHub Actions。
